scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @laces-out/web" "npm run dev -w @laces-out/api" "npm run dev -w @laces-out/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @laces-out/api && npm run build -w @laces-out/worker && npm run build -w @laces-out/espn-bridge && npm run build -w @laces-out/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker "npm run start -w @laces-out/web" "npm run start -w @laces-out/api" "npm run start -w @laces-out/worker"
scripts.runtime:smoke: npm run build -w @laces-out/api && npm run build -w @laces-out/worker && npm run build -w @laces-out/espn-bridge && npm run build -w @laces-out/web && node scripts/runtime-smoke.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
